_enable_posting: true (default): accept board posts. false makes this a read-only node.
_advertise_as_server: true (default): append '[vNet]' to this node's MeshCore name so clients discover. Set false to run a private node only people with the pKey can find it.
_advert_interval_hours: How often to re-flood this node's advert, set to 0 to never re-flood
